# Sparrow Collect

> Sparrow Collect is an AI-powered iPhone app (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767359453; Android coming later) that scans, identifies, and values collectibles across 56 categories. Values are built from marketplace listings and price data (eBay, TCGplayer, Cardmarket, Discogs, and other marketplace data), and each value shows how it was derived, so collectors can track portfolio value, compare live listings, set watchlist target-price alerts, and decide when to buy or sell. One app for trading cards, figures, vinyl, watches, LEGO, sneakers, comics, and more.

## What it does

- **Scan & identify**: Point your camera at an item; AI identifies the item, edition, and variant, and estimates its condition from the photo. Barcode and ISBN scanning too.
- **Value**: Low/mid/high price range, with how it was derived (how many market prices, which sources, which market: US, European, or both). When data is thin, the app says so instead of guessing. Shown in EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, KRW, AUD, or CAD.
- **Track**: Portfolio dashboard with total value, what you paid (incl. tax and shipping) against current value, biggest movers, and CSV export.
- **Alerts**: Add items to your watchlist with a target price and get notified when the market reaches it.
- **Deal discovery (Pro)**: Purchase mandates describe what you want and your budget; matching listings are surfaced as deals.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Scan and catalogue your items, see each value with how it was derived, and profit/loss against what you paid.
- **Sparrow Pro (monthly or yearly, via Apple In-App Purchase; price shown in the App Store)**: 10 purchase mandates, unlimited watchlist, unlimited Target Hit alerts, deal discovery, set completion for trading-card sets, advanced analytics.

## Pages

- [Categories](https://sparrowcollect.com/categories): The 56 collectible categories covered (trading cards, figures, vinyl, watches, LEGO, sneakers, comics, and more).
- [Guides](https://sparrowcollect.com/guides): In-depth collector guides and 80+ answered questions on identifying, grading, and valuing collectibles.

## Price guides

- [What are my Pokémon cards worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/pokemon-cards): Scan a Pokémon card with your phone to identify the card, set and variant and see a value built from TCGplayer and Cardmarket prices plus eBay listings.
- [How much are my Magic: The Gathering cards worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/magic-the-gathering-cards): Scan Magic: The Gathering cards to identify the card, set and edition and see a value built from Scryfall card prices and eBay listings.
- [What are my Yu-Gi-Oh! cards worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/yugioh-cards): Scan Yu-Gi-Oh! cards to identify the set and rarity and see a value built from Cardmarket and TCGplayer prices. Ghost Rares, Starlights and 1st Editions.
- [What is my sports card collection worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/sports-cards): Scan baseball, basketball, football and hockey cards to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Rookies and autographs in one app.
- [How much is my Funko Pop worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/funko-pop): Scan a Funko Pop to identify the figure, variant and exclusive edition and see a value built from eBay listings. Commons, chases, vaulted and convention grails.
- [How do I check the value of my LEGO sets?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/lego-sets): Scan a LEGO set (barcode works for sealed boxes) and see a value built from eBay listings, sealed or opened. Track retired sets across your whole collection.
- [What is my vinyl record collection worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/vinyl-records): Scan a record to identify the release and see a value built from Discogs and eBay listings, graded on the Goldmine scale.
- [How much are my retro video games worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/retro-video-games): Scan NES, SNES, N64, PlayStation and Sega games to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Track every game in one app.
- [How do I find the value of anime figures?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/anime-figures): Scan anime figures from Good Smile, Kotobukiya, Alter and Bandai to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Scale figures, Nendoroids, prizes.
- [How do I value my watch collection?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/watches): Photograph a watch to identify it and see a value built from eBay listings. Rolex, Omega, Seiko, vintage and modern, in one app.
- [What are my Disney Lorcana cards worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/lorcana-cards): Scan Disney Lorcana cards to identify the card and set and see a value built from Lorcast card prices and eBay listings. All sets and promos.
- [What are my Hot Toys figures worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/hot-toys): Scan Hot Toys 1/6 scale figures from Star Wars, Marvel and DC to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Track every figure in one app.
- [How much is my Warhammer collection worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/warhammer): Track the value of Warhammer 40K and Age of Sigmar miniatures, sealed or painted, with values built from eBay listings. Your whole army in one app.
- [What are my Gunpla model kits worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/gunpla): Scan Gunpla kits (HG, MG, PG, RG) to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Track built and sealed kits in one app.
- [How much are my Hot Wheels and diecast cars worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/diecast-hot-wheels): Scan Hot Wheels, Tomica and 1:18 scale diecast cars to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Track every car in one app.
- [How much are my sneakers worth?](https://sparrowcollect.com/value/sneakers): Scan a pair of sneakers to identify them and see a value built from eBay listings. Nike, Adidas, Jordan and collabs. Track every pair in one app.
